title: High Stakes Truth
tagline: Bet your bank on suspiciously specific facts.
description: True-or-false trivia at a 3D casino table. Bet your chips on what you know and try to beat The House.
longDescription: High Stakes Truth turns true-or-false trivia into a bet. Every claim gets a wager, from a cautious 25% to all-in, and The House, a masked dealer with opinions, reacts to every win and every bust. Tricky claims and deep cuts pay more.
role: Concept, game design, writing, UI and development
challenge: Make true-or-false trivia feel like a decision instead of a coin flip.
solution: Chip-based wagers (25%, 50%, 75% or all-in), payouts that rise with difficulty, a fact bank of 800+ claims tilted so 'always pick True' loses, and a 3D table with a dealer who talks back.
next: Grow the fact bank, add daily challenges and make the first round teach itself.
